from agent import shell

def Run(ctx, a):
    def ab(cmd):
        return shell.run("agent-browser " + cmd + " 2>&1", workdir=".", timeout=120000).stdout

    results = {}
    results["initial"] = ab("get text #empty")
    results["fill1"] = ab('fill "#new-todo" "Buy milk"')
    results["add1"] = ab("click #add-button")
    results["fill2"] = ab('fill "#new-todo" "Write tests"')
    results["add2"] = ab("click #add-button")
    results["list_text"] = ab("get text #list")
    results["count"] = ab("get count #list li")
    results["storage"] = ab("eval \"localStorage.getItem('todos')\"")
    results["input_value"] = ab("get value #new-todo")
    return results

from agent import shell

def Run(ctx, a):
    def ab(cmd):
        return shell.run("agent-browser " + cmd + " 2>&1", workdir=".", timeout=120000).stdout

    results = {}
    results["reload"] = ab("reload")
    results["count_after_reload"] = ab('get count "#list li"')
    results["check"] = ab('check "#list li:nth-child(1) input[type=checkbox]"')
    results["first_class"] = ab('get attr "#list li:nth-child(1)" class')
    results["storage_done"] = ab("eval \"JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('todos')).map(t => t.done).join(',')\"")
    results["reload2"] = ab("reload")
    results["checked_after_reload"] = ab('is checked "#list li:nth-child(1) input[type=checkbox]"')
    results["delete"] = ab('click "#list li:nth-child(1) .delete"')
    results["count_after_delete"] = ab('get count "#list li"')
    results["remaining"] = ab('get text "#list"')
    results["reload3"] = ab("reload")
    results["count_after_delete_reload"] = ab('get count "#list li"')
    results["storage_len"] = ab("eval \"JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('todos')).length\"")
    results["delete_last"] = ab('click "#list li:nth-child(1) .delete"')
    results["final_count"] = ab('get count "#list li"')
    results["empty_visible"] = ab("eval \"!document.getElementById('empty').hidden\"")
    results["storage_final"] = ab("eval \"localStorage.getItem('todos')\"")
    return results
